about: the user asks who won yesterday's Formula 1 race and how old the circuit is; search and Wikipedia both have answers

connector.none: no captured search connector; the Claude side serves the same responses through its HTTP mock

reads.note: agent tool: LangChain SerpAPI, GET https://serpapi.com/search?q=<model-written>&api_key=…; the query is model-written, so replies answer in turn (last repeats)

reads.note: agent tool: LangChain WikipediaQueryRun, GET /w/api.php?action=query&list=search&srsearch=<model-written>&format=json, then prop=extracts&explaintext&titles=<title> for the top results (topKResults 3)

branches: no IF/Switch: the agent answers, optionally after SerpAPI and/or Wikipedia calls
expected: SerpAPI for the result, Wikipedia for the circuit
expect.offline: The agent picks SerpAPI, Wikipedia or neither (model-driven); search queries are model-written, so SerpAPI replies answer in turn and Wikipedia answers by title. Simple Memory holds one turn per run. "Yesterday" is relative to n8n's wall clock; the fixture's results assume a run on 16 November 2026
